# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment

The incumbent is timing-feasible at 28 LUTs, 37 FFs, WNS 0.331 ns, and WHS 0.051 ns, and the frozen testbench passes. With `minimize_luts`, a candidate must reduce LUTs or keep LUTs equal and reduce FFs; setup and hold closure and every verification gate remain mandatory.

## Hypothesis

Use the receive shift register as the response-data register to remove the duplicate 8-bit register and its completion-time copy, reducing FF use and possibly LUT use without changing defined output behavior.

## Instruction for generator

In `spi_master_core`, remove `rsp_data_reg` and drive `rsp_data` from `rx_shift`; remove its reset and completion assignments. Preserve the receive shift schedule so its final sampled byte is held unchanged throughout `rsp_valid`, including response stalls, and changes only when the next command is accepted or reset occurs. Keep the top annotation `// @latency 33`, and preserve all `HALF_PERIOD` timing, handshake, reset, and bus behavior.
